question: Kiran lent ₹40,000 to Kishore on compound interest for 2 years, compounded annually. The rate to interest is 20%. What is the Compound Interest that Kiran will receive after 2 years?
solution:
Given:

Principal amount = ₹40,000

Rate of interest = 20%

Time = 2 years

Concept used:

Compound interest, CI = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

According to the concept,

The incurred compound interest

⇒ 40000(1 + 20/100)² - 40000

⇒ 57600 - 40000

⇒ ₹17,600

**∴ The compound interest that Kiran will receive after 2 years is ₹17,600.**
